desc:
Get comfy ☕ You have a little empty room, a theme and unlimited customization!

A new cosy theme every round, from autumn bedrooms to Grandma’s living room
Snug attics, balcony rooms and dreamy two-storey lofts
Soft colours, warm lamps and fluffy rugs, and you can recolour everything
Visit everyone’s rooms and vote. The cosiest wins 
Free spins every level up to grow your collection
